# #1599: Patch: a socket that closed before the first view says the game is gone, not 'Joining…'
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

If a match or co-op stream closes for good before the first game screen arrives — the match was voided, the connection gave up — the player today stares at a 'Joining the match…' spinner forever: a dead end dressed as a loading state. After the fix the screen says plainly that the game isn't available and offers the way back, like the existing 'This match isn't available' panel for refused joins.

## Why

On the match, co-op and watch routes, `view === null` falls through to `<Loading what="Joining …">` for every connection state except `refused` (`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx:317-346`, `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx:195-217`, `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx:208-216`). A `closed` connection with no view received is terminal — a voided match close (`VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE` 4410, `apps/web/src/game/net.ts:704-706`) or exhausted watch reconnects (~10 s) — but is presented as pending; on the watch route the connection words aren't even rendered in that branch.

## Proposal

Add a `connection === "closed" && view === null` branch per route rendering a terminal notice plus the way back, mirroring the `refused` panel. The watch route overlaps the open retry issue #1570 — if that lands first, this keeps the match and co-op halves; the terminal-notice shape is the same either way.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`, `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx`, `apps/web/src/together/WatchRoute.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/net.ts` (the existing close code).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Vitest with a fake socket: close with the voided code on match and co-op, or exhaust the watch reconnects, and assert a terminal notice and back link render instead of the Joining copy.
- [ ] The `refused` panel and normal joining flow are unchanged.

## Size and risks

Small, three route files. Care only to keep #1570's watcher-retry wording compatible; the match and co-op halves are unclaimed by it.
